mapper.insert: INSERT INTO youth_policy ( policy_no, policy_name, policy_keyword, policy_description, support_content, provider_institution_code, provider_institution_name, zip_cd, application_start_date, application_end_date, application_period_text, application_method, application_url, reference_url, min_age, max_age, income_condition_code, min_income, max_income, income_condition_text, qualification, synced_at ) VALUES ( #{policyNo}, #{policyName}, #{policyKeyword}, #{policyDescription}, #{supportContent}, #{providerInstitutionCode}, #{providerInstitutionName}, #{zipCd}, #{applicationStartDate}, #{applicationEndDate}, #{applicationPeriodText}, #{applicationMethod}, #{applicationUrl}, #{referenceUrl}, #{minAge}, #{maxAge}, #{incomeConditionCode}, #{minIncome}, #{maxIncome}, #{incomeConditionText}, #{qualification}, #{syncedAt} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE policy_name = new.policy_name, policy_keyword = new.policy_keyword, policy_description = new.policy_description, support_content = new.support_content, provider_institution_code = new.provider_institution_code, provider_institution_name = new.provider_institution_name, zip_cd = new.zip_cd, application_start_date = new.application_start_date, application_end_date = new.application_end_date, application_period_text = new.application_period_text, application_method = new.application_method, application_url = new.application_url, reference_url = new.reference_url, min_age = new.min_age, max_age = new.max_age, income_condition_code = new.income_condition_code, min_income = new.min_income, max_income = new.max_income, income_condition_text = new.income_condition_text, qualification = new.qualification, synced_at = new.synced_at

AND (yp.application_end_date IS NULL OR yp.application_end_date >= CURDATE())
AND (yp.min_age IS NULL OR yp.min_age <= #{age}) AND (yp.max_age IS NULL OR yp.max_age >= #{age})
AND (yp.min_income IS NULL OR yp.min_income <= #{income}) AND (yp.max_income IS NULL OR yp.max_income >= #{income})
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM youth_policy_region ypr WHERE ypr.youth_policy_id = yp.youth_policy_id AND (ypr.region_code = #{regionCode} OR ypr.is_nationwide = TRUE) )

mapper.select:
SELECT yp.youth_policy_id, yp.policy_name, yp.policy_keyword, yp.provider_institution_name, yp.application_start_date, yp.application_end_date, CASE WHEN yp.application_start_date IS NOT NULL AND yp.application_end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(yp.application_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(yp.application_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) WHEN yp.application_start_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(yp.application_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ~') WHEN yp.application_end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('~ ', DATE_FORMAT(yp.application_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) ELSE yp.application_period_text END AS application_period, CASE WHEN yp.application_end_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(yp.application_end_date, CURDATE()) END AS d_day FROM youth_policy yp
ORDER BY yp.application_end_date IS NULL, yp.application_end_date ASC, yp.youth_policy_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT yp.youth_policy_id, yp.policy_name, yp.policy_keyword, yp.policy_description, yp.support_content, yp.provider_institution_name, yp.application_start_date, yp.application_end_date, CASE WHEN yp.application_start_date IS NOT NULL AND yp.application_end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(yp.application_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(yp.application_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) WHEN yp.application_start_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(yp.application_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ~') WHEN yp.application_end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('~ ', DATE_FORMAT(yp.application_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) ELSE yp.application_period_text END AS application_period, yp.min_age, yp.max_age, yp.min_income, yp.max_income, yp.income_condition_text, yp.qualification, yp.application_method, yp.application_url, yp.reference_url FROM youth_policy yp WHERE yp.youth_policy_id = #{youthPolicyId}
